sql:
SELECT p.id, p.conversation_id, CASE WHEN p.source_root=s.source_root THEN 0 ELSE 1
            END FROM ah_sessions p JOIN ah_sessions s ON s.id=?1 WHERE p.harness=s.harness AND
            p.rollout_native_id=?2 AND p.id<>s.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.source_root=s.source_root
            THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.id
steps: SEARCH p USING INDEX ah_sessions_rollout (harness=? AND rollout_native_id=?)

sql:
SELECT v.prefix_digest, v.own_ordinal FROM ah_lineage_validation v
             JOIN ah_sessions s ON s.revision_id=v.revision_id
             WHERE s.id=?1 AND v.end_ordinal=?2 AND v.byte_len=?3 AND v.valid=1
steps: SEARCH v USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_ah_lineage_validation_1 (revision_id=? AND end_ordinal=? AND byte_len=?)

sql: SELECT conversation FROM ah_reader_head WHERE parent=?1 AND conversation>?2 ORDER BY conversation LIMIT ?3
steps: SEARCH ah_reader_head USING COVERING INDEX ah_reader_children (parent=? AND conversation>?)

sql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ah_reader_version WHERE source=?1 AND state<>'retired')
steps: SEARCH ah_reader_version USING COVERING INDEX ah_reader_version_source (source=?)

sql: UPDATE ah_reader_version SET state='retired' WHERE source=?1 AND revision<>?2 AND state<>'retired'
steps: SEARCH ah_reader_version USING COVERING INDEX ah_reader_version_source (source=?)
